title: DOJ: trial under Military Order Number One

tellings.quote: the DOJ said that I'd be tried under military order number one, which is Guantanamo status.

plain: A computer hacker named Gary McKinnon, who says he got into US government computers, tells of what happened while the US tried to bring him to trial, sometime between 2002 and 2008. He says the Department of Justice, the US government's main law enforcement department, told him he would be tried under Military Order Number One, a wartime presidential order, which he describes as giving him the same status as the prisoners held at the US military prison at Guantanamo Bay. If true, it would show how seriously the US government took what he had found or done.
